ABOUT COLLEGE
Puthimari College, a premier institution of higher education in Puthimari area was established on August
                5, 1981. The establishment of the college is the outcome of the effort vanguard people of the area
                because the people felt that the people of the greater Puthimari area had been deprived of access to
                higher education owing to the absence of higher educational institution in the locality. Thanks to the
                initiative taken by the enthuasiastic people of the area, for setting up of the college by the bank of
                river Puthimari that comes forward to fulfill the long-felt thirst for higher education for the young
                generation. Presently, the academic activities of the institution widen beyond the territory of the
                district. It is now acknowledged as one of the pioneers of higher education in Assam. Meanwhile, the
                College has attained "B" grade in NAAC Re-accreditation in 2012.The college stands at Soneswar by the Puthimari River in the district of Kamrup(R). It is 40 kms to the
                north of Guwahati, the capital of Assam. 31 No. National Highway connects the college by a PWD road at
                Baihata. It is situated in a sylvan area with the Puthimari River in the west and Alta village in the
                east.
